task: Corrected D012 final validation and managed visual review
end_user_goal: ten canonical D012 mural review comparisons, anatomy/identity/source correctness, preserve existing chapters

scope.existing_chapters: preserve and verify unchanged apart from intended D012 corrected selections

shared_character_boundary: D012 verses 12-1 to 12-10 describe infant, growing, roaring, descending, searching, and lifting forms of a boar without prescribing combat weapons or extra limbs; natural-boar anatomy/no-weapons constraints apply to D012 non-combat scenes only. Stotra Nidhi's D013 verses 13-4 to 13-7 explicitly describe the mace duel, discus use, and toe-stomp. Preserve the shared identity and palette; D013's plan owns any scene-specific pose, limb count, and action, with no invented form.

fresh_independent_visual_review.coverage: all ten selected D012 raw PNGs, including the eight unchanged leads; no sampling
fresh_independent_visual_review.per_image: Open exact raw at native resolution and inspect full frame plus relevant close details (anatomy, faces, hands/feet, tusk/Earth contact, witnesses, scene action as applicable). Independently compare against that stanza canonical text, intake reference, art/plans/d012.json, art/bible/series.json, Varaha identity reference and relevant character bible(s).
fresh_independent_visual_review.report: Write one exact-hash/version-bound report per selected image. Record actual full-frame and detail visual observations, actual paths and hashes of viewed raw and detail evidence, scene/source comparison, anatomy/identity observations, findings and limitations. Use real inspection timestamps. No templated claims, inferred observations, or claims of views not performed.
fresh_independent_visual_review.custody: All raw paths below must be readable from the managed test context and match SHA-256. If any raw or required reference is unavailable, stop the review and repair custody before a pass.
fresh_independent_visual_review.outcome: Do not pass a selected image with unmet source must_show or unresolved anatomy/identity defects. Keep all findings open and route them through the existing AXI gate/root decision process.

scene_contract.source_summary: Svayambhuva Manu sees the Earth submerged at an untimely time and comes with sages to Brahma, who is content in service to the Lord's feet.
must_show: Brahma seated on a lotus in Satyaloka, exactly four total heads with three faces visible frontally and exactly four distinct attached arms.
Manu approaches with a small group of sages; ordinary human figures have natural two-arm anatomy.
A small, distant Earth motif lies beneath or beside primordial waters to establish the crisis.
scene_contract.composition: Wide horizontal scene with Brahma and Manu clearly separated; the waters and Earth remain a small supporting motif, not a second scene panel.
avoid: Narayana reclining in the water; this verse centers Manu's arrival at Brahma
glossy surfaces, metallic gold, cinematic rays, text, montage panels
